7900.html:
7900 *parihasta 'having the hand round it'. [Cf. parihastá- m. 'amulet put round the hand to secure birth of a child' AV. — hásta-]
    Bi. parihath, °hat 'handle of plough'.
    Addenda: *parihasta- [Cf. Ir. *paridastya- in Ishk. pərēšt, X. Sar. parδist 'bracelet', Rosh. parδēs, Yazgh. pərδast EVSh 58]

11147.html:
11147 lōbha¹ m. 'eager desire' Mn. [√lubh¹]
    Pa. lōbha- m. 'greed', Pk. lōha- m.; L.awāṇ. lōˋ 'longing'; P. lohaṛ m. 'lust, violence, oppression' (see also *lōbha-²); A. loh 'desire'; M. loho m. 'tenderness, affection'; — Si. loba 'desire, greed' (ES 77) ← Pa.
    lōbhin-; nirlōbha-.
